# Midnight Helper

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20the%20community-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/kBHaHcsASQ)
[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-download-F16436?logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/midnight-helper)

💬 **Need help or want to help translate?** Join the [Midnight Helper Discord](https://discord.gg/kBHaHcsASQ).

Midnight Helper is an all-in-one World of Warcraft addon for quick weekly planning and character management.

It combines Delves, Great Vault progress, alt snapshots, in-delve coaching, professions utilities, leveling guides, and city guide helpers in one compact UI.

## Features

- **Midnight Codex** — handbook (Start Here, currencies with live balances, weekly loop, delves, M+, raid, world, professions) with buttons into each tab.
- Delves dashboard with currencies, bountiful tracking, Great Vault helper, and travel assistant.
- **Delve Coach** — tips for all 14 Midnight delves, including Gnarldor Isle, The Ring of Glory and the Season 2 Nemesis delve Venomfall Deeps; boss 3D preview; party share to group chat.
- **Delve consumables** — RAID-R Mini / Trovehunter's Bounty popup and minimap buttons (in-delve only).
- **Valeera curio advisor** — Delves tab + repair/gossip popup.
- Account snapshot with per-character vault status, keys, shards, and profession currency tooltips.
- Profession tools, Role Academy, Macros, Consumables, and the Midnight 80–90 Leveling Guides tab.
- **Class-layout keybind coach** — reads your live spellbook and shows a recommended keyboard layout per spec, with spell tooltips.
- **On-screen route arrow** — a standalone rotating arrow + Blizzard user-waypoint for rares, treasures, achievements and the weekly reset route. Stands down automatically when TomTom or WaypointUI is driving.
- SMC City Guide with waypoints and optional weekly checklist.
- Optional TomTom / WaypointUI integration (Blizzard user-waypoint fallback when neither is present).
- **Languages:** English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (BR), Italiano, Nederlands (`/mh lang`).

See `CURSEFORGE_DESCRIPTION.md` for the full feature list.

## Commands

- `/mh` or `/midnight` — toggle main window
- `/mh codex` — Midnight Codex (Start Here)
- `/mh coach` — Delve Coach
- `/mh items` — delve consumables panel
- `/mh lang auto|en|de|fr|es|pt|it|nl` — language
- `/mh settings` — quick settings
- `/mh changelog` — changelog window
- `/mh debug` — debug mode

## Requirements

- WoW Retail
- Current TOC interface: `120007` (patch 12.0.7 "Midnight")
- Optional: TomTom (for enhanced waypoint flow)

## Installation

1. Download the latest release zip.
2. Extract the `MidnightHelper` folder into:
   - `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/`
3. Restart WoW (or `/reload` if already in-game).
4. Enable **Midnight Helper** in the AddOns list.

## Maintainer checks

- Lua syntax: run `python tools/lua_syntax_check.py` from the repo root to compile every addon Lua file with `luac -p` (Lua 5.1) and catch syntax errors before release. This same check runs automatically on GitHub for pushes and pull requests.

## Notes

- Alt snapshot data is refreshed on login and relevant update events.
- Some Blizzard APIs only return progress while logged on that character, so the alt view reflects each character's latest saved state.

## Credits and References

- [Wowhead](https://www.wowhead.com/) for public game-reference validation and lookup support.
- [Icy Veins](https://www.icy-veins.com/wow/) for external leveling and talent reference links.
- [TomTom](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/tomtom) for optional waypoint integration.
- Art: the screen icons were generated locally with an open image model (Z-Image Turbo) from text
  prompts, then picked and cropped by us; the logo was made with Google Gemini. No Blizzard artwork
  was used as input for the icons.

## License

The MIT licence in [LICENSE](https://github.com/Huijting/MidnightHelper/blob/main/LICENSE) covers Midnight Helper's own work only. The parts and data of others listed in THIRD_PARTY.txt
keep their own terms.

Every third-party part, its source and its licence: [THIRD_PARTY.txt](https://github.com/Huijting/MidnightHelper/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.txt).

## Disclaimer

Midnight Helper is a fan-made addon and is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or specifically approved by Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

World of Warcraft and Blizzard are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. in the U.S. and/or other countries.

Game data and recommendations may change with patches, hotfixes, or tuning updates.

## Reporting Issues

Please open an issue on the project repository with:

- What happened
- Expected behavior
- Repro steps
- Character/realm and region
- Screenshot (if applicable)

# Midnight Helper 5.12.0: a start that grows with your new character, an order panel, and the whole profession route

Found something odd, or does everything just work? Tell us: `/mh report` in game, a comment here on CurseForge, or the
feedback form on midnighthelper.com.

This version adds new files: after updating, restart the game once (a `/reload` is not enough for new files).

## Forever: How you play for a new character

- Under level 10 (or under the level your role starts), How you play begins with a block that grows with you, level by
  level: the keys you can press now, **Order now** with the key for each step, and **Next**: the next new spell, at
  which level and on which key.
- **Learn now at your trainer:** a new spell of your level that you have not learned yet, with its key. Short of money?
  It says how much you still need: kill a few enemies, loot them, and sell grey items to a vendor.
- Spells that are no real step get their own short line: Auto Shot, the up-close emergency (Raptor Strike, Frost Nova),
  "Low on health?", "Low on mana?" (the wand, Life Tap), "Several enemies?" (Thunder Clap) and "Enemy casting a
  spell?" (Earth Shock).
- Every level in How you play now says so: "from lvl 18", "at lvl 12", "(lvl 4)", "- lvl 10:".
- Raptor Strike says it needs a melee weapon in your hand.

## Forever: the order panel

- A small panel on your screen with what to press: your order with its keys, the lines for low health or mana, what you
  can learn now and what comes next. It updates as you learn and level, and stays on screen in a fight.
- Drag it where you like; Shift+scroll makes it bigger or smaller; it stays where you put it. The lock next to the cross
  keeps it in place, and clicks go through it.
- On by itself under level 10. Above that, switch it on yourself: Keys & macros → *Order panel on your screen*, or
  `/mh order`. Then it shows the order of your direction, with only the spells you know.

## Forever: the key block

- **Better spell, better key:** from Hunter's Mark (level 6) key 1 is Hunter's Mark and Auto Shot moves to Shift-Z
  (Serpent Sting and Arcane Shot start Auto Shot by themselves). Mage: Arcane Blast takes 1; a Frost mage gets
  Frostbolt on 1. Rogue: Mutilate or Hemorrhage takes 1. Shaman: Stormstrike takes 1. Midnight Helper tells you once
  when a key changes. Don't want it? Switch off *Swap keys when you learn a better spell*.
- **Druid:** your caster keys do nothing in Bear and Cat Form, so a press never pulls you out of your form (switch:
  *Druid: caster keys do nothing in Bear and Cat Form*). Swipe as a bear is on 4, Ferocious Bite as a cat on C.
- **Rogue:** Evasion, Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush do nothing in Stealth, so you do not break it before your opener
  (switch: *Rogue: Evasion, Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush do nothing in Stealth*). Death Mark works in Stealth.
- **Warrior:** Sunder Armor is on 4 in Defensive Stance.
- How you play names the key where the spell is now, also on the old key block.

## Forever: professions, reagents and ammo

- **Skill up** has the whole route to 300 for each profession (*Route to 300*): every step from your skill, when to go
  to the trainer, and one shopping list. The route starts with a bar and one line with what to do now. Enchanting now
  has a recipe from skill 1.
- **Class reagents and ammo:** Do this now tells you when you are short of a reagent for a spell you know, or of
  ammo, with the nearest seller. Find has new lists *Reagent*, *Arrow* and *Bullet* with an arrow to the seller.
- A big alert with a sound when your ammo or a reagent runs low (50 ammo, 3 reagents; you can change both). Switch:
  *Alert when ammo or reagents run out*.
- **Bags:** Do this now tells you about a bag you can put on, or one bigger than your smallest bag, with a button:
  *Put it on* or *Swap*.

## Forever: more

- **Gear:** a small gain that costs you Stamina or armor elsewhere reads "about equal" instead of "Upgrade", and the
  gear line names your role.
- **Dual Spec** advice warns that switching can change your action bars.
- **Cenarion Circle:** the tip now sends you to the quests in Silithus; Blizzard switched off the repeat turn-in.
- Lacerate is only offered when you have its talent. The reagent check knows every rank of Prayer of Fortitude, and
  every kind of ammo in your bags counts.

## Both games: one window at a time

- Opening a Midnight Helper window closes the others, so they no longer pile up on top of each other. **Back** and
  **Home** above the window take you to the one before or to the main window. Rather keep several open? Settings →
  *Keep several windows open*.

## Midnight

- **Codex → Ascendant Venomstones:** how many you get from each kind of content (raid bosses, Mythic+, Bountiful
  Coffers, Nightmare Prey).

## Fixed

- Forever: Midnight Helper's key macros are your character's own again; characters no longer overwrite each other's.

## Credits

- Includes data from "Polestar Recorder sessions" by the Polestar authors
  ([github.com/fitzforge/polestar](https://github.com/fitzforge/polestar)),
  [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), filtered and reduced. The Polestar authors do not
  endorse Midnight Helper.
- Includes data from [AllTheThings](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings), MIT licence (the licence text is in
  the addon).
- Quest names and quest order include data from the Spoken addon, partly from
  [Efficient Games](https://efficient.games/), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), reduced.
- Uses QuestieDB's quest data if you have QuestieDB installed; none of it is included in Midnight Helper.

Have fun!

# Midnight Helper 5.11.0: which click heals what, a travel planner with flight paths, and help after you die

Found something odd, or does everything just work? Tell us: `/mh report` in game, a comment here on CurseForge, or the
feedback form on midnighthelper.com.

This version adds new files: after updating, restart the game once (a `/reload` is not enough for new files).

## Both games: which click heals what

- A big card with a drawn mouse shows which click heals what on your group frames, live: hold Alt, Ctrl or Shift and
  the card shows that layer. Every spell has its own tooltip. Open it with `/mh clickcard`. Size with Shift+scroll; it
  can be see-through outside a group.
- It reads your active DandersFrames click profile. Without one it shows Midnight Helper's own layout.
- **On paper:** the button *Print (website)* gives the key block code, now with your clicks in it. Paste it on
  midnighthelper.com (Key block page) for one sheet with your keys and your clicks, per layer, with spell and rank.
  Spells you have not learned yet say so ("level 24", "talent").

## Forever: heals on a click on your group frames

- Switch on *Heals on a click on your group frames* (needs the DandersFrames addon): Midnight Helper makes a click
  profile with the heals, dispels and res your character knows, and keeps it up to date when you learn a new spell or
  rank. Druid, Priest, Paladin and Shaman. Switch it off and what DandersFrames had before comes back.
- *Keep left-click for targeting* (on by default): a plain left-click still targets and right-click opens the menu;
  the heals are on Alt and Ctrl. Good when you heal on the side, or in Cat or Bear Form.
- Druids also get Wild Growth, Rebirth (Shift + middle button) and Innervate once they have them.

## Forever: the way there, with flight paths

- The arrow and "The way there" now use flight paths you know, boats, zeppelins and your teleports and Hearthstone,
  and pick the quickest. Midnight Helper learns your flight points each time you open a flight map, and times your own
  flights and boat rides, so the minutes get better as you play.
- A small route panel next to the arrow shows every step with its time (minutes:seconds) and the total. On the flight
  map, the stop to click has a gold ring. Don't want it? Switch off *Route steps next to the arrow*.
- The trainer arrow picks the trainer you reach quickest, not the one in a straight line. Teleport: Moonglade counts.
- Class quest cards say how you get there, and say "upstairs, inside" when the person you need stands upstairs.

## Forever: class quests

- Kill and collect steps point at the nearest of all the places where that creature or item is ("3 areas, this one is
  nearest"), and at the spawn closest to you.
- Mouse over a step that asks for an item (Earthroot): the game's tooltip, how many you have, and which of your other
  characters have it and whether they can mail it to you (with the Syndicator addon).
- Curing the Sick: a warning to use the salve only out of combat, and how many doses you have left against how many you
  still need.

## Forever: rares

- A window when a rare comes into sight, with buttons to target it, show it in Find, or set a waypoint.
- The rare in 3D, in that window and when you hover a rare in Find.
- Midnight Helper remembers what you looted from each rare and shows it ("Your loot (3 kills)").

## Forever: after you die

- A window shows how far your corpse is, how long the run takes as a ghost, what the Spirit Healer costs at your level,
  and has an arrow to your corpse. Close it and it stays closed for that death. The arrow goes away as soon as you live
  again. Don't want it? Switch off *Window after you die*.

## Forever: more

- **Do this now** always shows how worn your gear is, next to your free bag slots: green, yellow or red. Mouse over it
  for your most worn items and the nearest vendor who repairs; click it for the arrow there.
- **Your race** in How you play, tab Start: what your race gives you, for your own class.
- **Gear check** also shows your legs, and updates as soon as you enchant something.
- **Oath of Light** lasts 1 hour since the Forever hotfix of 25 November; the Holy Paladin text says so.
- **Quiet helpers** has more settings that work in Forever: the missing buff icon, the upgrade notice, the arrow size
  and meters, the minimap icon, the quick bar, and the cast warning bars.
- Commands that only work in Midnight are hidden in Forever, and say so when you type one.
- The key block code names your whole character (first and last name), and shows the spell behind each of Midnight
  Helper's own key macros.

## Both games: more

- **Move** has a Done bar at the top (or press Escape), and the cast warning bars can be moved too.
- **Thank strangers for a buff**: a buff you get during a fight is thanked when the fight ends.
- **Key block**: Undo never takes off what you put on a button yourself, and the window says first what Undo will do.
  *Update* also puts back what is missing.

## Fixed

- Forever: Move no longer stops with an error on some bars.

## Credits

- Includes data from "Polestar Recorder sessions" by the Polestar authors
  ([github.com/fitzforge/polestar](https://github.com/fitzforge/polestar)),
  [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), filtered and reduced. The Polestar authors do not
  endorse Midnight Helper.
- Includes data from [AllTheThings](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings), MIT licence (the licence text is in
  the addon).
- Quest names and quest order include data from the Spoken addon, partly from
  [Efficient Games](https://efficient.games/), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), reduced.
- Uses QuestieDB's quest data if you have QuestieDB installed; none of it is included in Midnight Helper.

Have fun!

# Midnight Helper 5.10.0: which weapon, How you play in tabs, and your other characters in tooltips

Found something odd, or does everything just work? Tell us: `/mh report` in game, a comment here on CurseForge, or the
feedback form on midnighthelper.com.

This version adds new files: after updating, restart the game once (a `/reload` is not enough for new files).

## Both games: your other characters in tooltips

- **Recipes**: which of your other characters have that profession, with their skill. In WoW Forever also "needs 50",
  "can learn it" or "knows it".
- **Ingredients**: which of your other characters have a profession that uses it.
- **Weapons and armor you can send**: who can wear it, from which level, and whether its item level is higher than what
  they wear in that slot now.
- In WoW Forever only characters you can mail to: the same realm, and characters of the other faction are listed apart
  ("other faction, can't mail").
- A bank character? Mark it, and it is left out of "who can wear this": the **Bank** button on its row in Characters
  (Forever), or `/mh alttip bank <name>`.
- A character counts once you have logged in on it with this version. Don't want it? Switch off *Your other characters
  in item tooltips*, or `/mh alttip off`.

## Forever: which weapon?

How you play has a new block for every class: **Which weapon?** It tells you which weapon kinds suit you, which ones you
can already use, and where you learn the others (a trainer of your own faction, from which level). It changes with
your level and your race. Druids: in Bear Form and Cat Form your attacks do your weapon's damage per second, so a
two-hander almost always wins.

The stats sentence in Do this now starts with what counts most: weapon damage per second for fighters, spell damage or
healing for casters and healers. Warlocks: spell damage first, then Intellect and Spirit, which count the same.

## Forever: How you play in tabs

No more one long page. How you play now has tabs on the left: **Start**, **Your keys**, **Weapon & stats**, **Group**
and **Levels**, with the headings of the open tab under them. Click a heading to jump there. It remembers the tab you
used last. The text is the same, only divided. Every way in (`/mh play`, the key block, Do this now) opens this page.

## Forever: Gear check for enchants

- A small window next to your character window shows the enchant on every slot that can have one, or *no enchant*.
  Armor kits show their name.
- Do this now says how many slots have no enchant.
- Enchanters see which enchants they can make themselves.
- Don't want it? Switch off *Gear check: enchants next to your character window*.

## Forever: "better than what you wear" counts more

- The enchant (or armor kit) on what you wear now counts. If you would lose one, the line says so.
- Spell damage and healing on items count for casters and healers, and for Retribution and Protection Paladins.
  One-school lines (for example Fire damage) count only when your direction casts that school.
- This works the same in the tooltip, the quest reward hint, the pickup notice and the bags-full list.

## Forever: taunts on the mouse

With `/mh mouseover on`, Growl, Taunt, Mocking Blow and Distracting Shot go to the enemy under your mouse.

## Fixed

- The key block window no longer says "nothing changes" once your block is already on your bars.

## Credits

- Includes data from "Polestar Recorder sessions" by the Polestar authors
  ([github.com/fitzforge/polestar](https://github.com/fitzforge/polestar)),
  [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), filtered and reduced. The Polestar authors do not
  endorse Midnight Helper.
- Includes data from [AllTheThings](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings), MIT licence (the licence text is in
  the addon).
- Quest names and quest order include data from the Spoken addon, partly from
  [Efficient Games](https://efficient.games/), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), reduced.
- Uses QuestieDB's quest data if you have QuestieDB installed; none of it is included in Midnight Helper.

Have fun!

# Midnight Helper 5.9.1: the 12 x 4 key block in Midnight, and Ctrl+Shift+click to disenchant in Forever

Want new things sooner and help test them? We put out betas regularly: set the release type of Midnight Helper in the
CurseForge app to **Beta**. Found something odd, or does everything just work? Tell us: `/mh report` in game, a comment
here on CurseForge, or the feedback form on midnighthelper.com.

## Midnight: the 12 x 4 key block

The second key block layout from Forever is now in Midnight too. The old block stays the default.

- **The same 12 keys on every bar**: 1 2 3 4, Q E R F, Z X C V. First without a modifier, then with Shift, then with
  Ctrl, then with Alt.
- **The same job on the same key, for every spec**: E is your interrupt, R moves you, Z X C are your defensives, V is
  crowd control. Healers: C is your big emergency heal, your normal heals are on 1, 2 and 3. Which spell goes where was
  checked per spec.
- **Ctrl holds your things**: Ctrl-F combat potion, Ctrl-Z health potion, Ctrl-C healthstone, Ctrl-V and Ctrl-X your
  trinkets.
- **Why these keys?** explains the job of every key.
- **Two extra keys, if you want them**: 5 becomes *Interact With Target*, and Shift-Space calls Blizzard's random
  favorite mount. Press it again to get off, but never in the air.
- Does Blizzard's Single-Button Assistant sit on one of your keys? Midnight Helper never covers it. Drag it to another
  place, then press *Update (add new spells)* in `/mh block`.

## Key block: switch with one button

- A **Layout** button in the key block window (`/mh block`) switches between the old block and 12 x 4. Midnight Helper
  takes the block off your bars, switches, and places it again. Click again to go back.
- The trinket places only show a trinket with a *Use:* effect, because only that one can go on a key. The tooltip names
  the trinket you wear.

## Forever: disenchant with Ctrl+Shift+click

For enchanters: hold **Ctrl+Shift** and click a weapon or armor in your bags, and Midnight Helper disenchants it. It
works in Blizzard's bags and in Baganator. The tooltip tells you when an item can. Never in combat, and without Ctrl+Shift
your bags work as always. Don't want it? Switch off *Ctrl+Shift+click disenchants* in the quiet helpers.

## Forever: buffs

- The buff button casts your buff **on you**, whatever you target. No more clicking yourself first.
- No more *runs out soon* when someone else gave you a stronger version than you know (a higher rank, or a group buff
  like Arcane Brilliance). Your own cast could not replace it anyway. When it is gone, Midnight Helper asks for yours.

## Forever: key block

- The buttons show the icon of what the key does **now**: in Bear Form you see Maul and Growl, not Wrath.
- A spell you just learned, for example from a quest, is on its key right away.
- The trainer window names the keys of the layout you use, with the form when a key only works in a form, for example
  "Maul -> 1 (Bear Form)".

## Fixed

- Dutch: the *Doe dit nu* window is called by its Dutch name everywhere.

## Credits

- Includes data from "Polestar Recorder sessions" by the Polestar authors
  ([github.com/fitzforge/polestar](https://github.com/fitzforge/polestar)),
  [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), filtered and reduced. The Polestar authors do not
  endorse Midnight Helper.
- Includes data from [AllTheThings](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings), MIT licence (the licence text is in
  the addon).
- Quest names and quest order include data from the Spoken addon, partly from
  [Efficient Games](https://efficient.games/), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), reduced.
- Uses QuestieDB's quest data if you have QuestieDB installed; none of it is included in Midnight Helper.

Have fun!

# Midnight Helper 5.9.0: a key block with the same 12 keys on every bar, and a group check

Want new things sooner and help test them? We put out betas regularly: set the release type of Midnight Helper in the
CurseForge app to **Beta**. Found something odd, or does everything just work? Tell us: `/mh report` in game, a comment
here on CurseForge, or the feedback form on midnighthelper.com.

Everything in this release is for **WoW Forever**.

## Key block: a second layout, "12 x 4"

The old key block stays the default. Want the new one? Type `/mh block undo` if your block is placed, then
`/mh block style 12x4`, open `/mh block` and place it again.

- **The same 12 keys on four bars**: 1 2 3 4, Q E R F, Z X C V. First without a modifier, then with Shift, then with
  Ctrl, then with Alt (your own bar). No more 5, T, G or F1-F4.
- **The same job on the same key, for every class**: E is your interrupt, R moves you, Z X C are your defensives, V is
  crowd control, and if you heal, C is your big heal and Shift-C your quick heal. Which spell goes where was worked out
  per class, so you don't have to guess for a class you never played.
- **Ctrl holds your things**: Ctrl-F bandage, Ctrl-Z health potion, Ctrl-X mana potion, Ctrl-C healthstone, Ctrl-V
  trinket. Midnight Helper puts the best one from your bags there.
- **Why these keys?** A button in the key block window explains the job of every key, without spell names.
- **One layout for all your characters**: your keys count for every Forever character. When a character still has the
  other layout on its bars, Midnight Helper says so at login, with a *Fix it now* button.
- **Two extra keys, if you want them**: Midnight Helper asks once. 5 becomes *Interact With Target* (talk to, loot or pick
  up what you target; a key you already had for it keeps working), and Shift-Space calls your fastest mount. A character
  without a mount gets it as soon as it learns one. Undo any time: `/mh block extras off`.
- Placing the block now also frees the keys of the other layout, so no old key keeps pressing a block button.
- At a low level, a key whose spell you don't have yet holds the spell you do have (for example Immolate on 3 for a
  young Warlock). A spell is never asked for on two keys, and *Later* on a question about a new spell is remembered.

## How you play shows your keys

*How you play* now names the keys of the layout you chose, for all nine classes. A spell without a key in that layout
says *block D*.

## Do this now

- **Upgrades in your bags** come first, with *Wear it* and *Not this one*. Switch it off in the settings if you don't
  want it.
- A **How you play** button opens the play card of this character.
- Left of your money you see how many **free bag slots** you have: orange when almost full, red when full.
- Your class quest card and *Do this now* show **how far you are**, for example "Vile Familiar Head: 4/6".

## Group check: buffs and consumables

A new window for your group, like the ready check window in Midnight. It opens at a ready check and with
`/mh readyboard`. Per player: the class buffs (Arcane Intellect, Fortitude, Mark of the Wild, a Blessing) and who in the
group can give them. For yourself also your elixir, food, weapon buff, health and mana potion, and a healthstone when
there is a Warlock in the group. Click a buff you can give to cast it. It closes when a fight starts. Don't want it at
every ready check? `/mh readyboard auto off`.

## Dungeon quests and QuestieDB

- If you have the **QuestieDB** addon installed, Midnight Helper uses its quest data where it has no place of its own: in the
  dungeon quest lists, and a *Ready to turn in* line with a button for the arrow in *Do this now*. Midnight Helper's own
  data always comes first. Switch: *Use QuestieDB if you have it*.
- A quest that has two versions with the same name shows one row, and doing either one counts for the quest after it.
- A quest you only get inside the dungeon is listed under the quests you get inside.

## Fixed

- The trainer arrow no longer sends you to a trainer far away when the trainer next to you can teach you.
- Warrior: key 3 no longer holds Mortal Strike when you don't have that talent; it uses Bloodthirst or Shield Slam.
- Priest: *How you play* no longer says that Chastise does not work in Shadowform (it does since the hotfix of 23 Nov).
- The buttons of Midnight Helper's questions are now in your own language.
- No more error at login when a macro on a key block button was lost, for example after the game was shut down
  suddenly. Midnight Helper puts the right macro back.
- In the old block, T and Shift-T use Forever's health potions and healthstones.
- A few class quest facts were corrected.
